title: Amelia | Leaf Print Blouse with Vintage Charm
bodyHtml:
Nature meets effortless style in this botanical blouse with a timeless vintage feel. The soft rounded neckline and relaxed half-sleeves make it perfect for warm days, while the delicate leaf print brings fresh, garden-inspired character to your everyday wardrobe. Throw it on with white trousers, a linen skirt, or layer it over a slip dress—this is the kind of piece you'll reach for again and again.

Why you'll love it

  • Leaf print design – a beautiful botanical pattern that works with nearly everything in your wardrobe
  • Half-sleeves – airy and comfortable for warm weather without feeling bare
  • Rounded neckline – classic and flattering, works across different body shapes
  • Decorative buttons – a charming detail that lifts the whole piece
  • Vintage-inspired silhouette – romantic and timeless, never feels dated
  • True versatility – dresses up for drinks with friends or down for weekend errands
  • Inclusive sizing – available from XS to 5XL, because great style fits everyone

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
